in_marathi.name: Sharwanidra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanidra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharwanidra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Sharva' meaning peace and 'Nidra' meaning sleep or unconsciousness. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is considered the god of wisdom and knowledge. It symbolizes the deep, unconscious state of the mind where wisdom and knowledge are revealed.
